skills.summary: Build a character with wants, flaws, voice
skills.job: Build a character profile that gives a writer a want, a need, a flaw, a voice and a contradiction to write from.
triggers: create a character for my story
gotchas: Listing traits that never create a choice
A backstory with no link to the plot
Making every character speak alike

skills.summary: Design a setting that supports the story
skills.job: Design a fictional world, its rules, places, factions and history only as far as the story needs, with consequences that connect.
triggers: create the history of my world
gotchas: Building the map and not the pressure on the characters
Rules that change when convenient
Writing a lore dump the reader never needs

skills.summary: Outline a plot with turns and stakes
skills.job: Turn a premise into a scene-level outline with a goal, obstacles, turning points and an ending that pays off the setup.
gotchas: Events with no cause between them
A middle that only repeats the same obstacle
An ending that solves things with luck

skills.summary: Write one scene with a goal and a turn
skills.job: Write a single scene in which a character wants something, meets resistance and ends changed, using concrete sensory detail.
triggers: turn this beat into a scene
gotchas: Starting before the scene gets interesting
Characters announcing their feelings
Ending with the same situation as the start

skills.summary: Make dialogue sound like different people
skills.job: Revise dialogue so each speaker has a distinct voice, subtext carries the meaning and tags and beats are used with care.
gotchas: Making speech realistic instead of readable
Dialogue that explains facts both know
Overusing tags and adverbs

skills.summary: Draft a poem from an image or feeling
skills.job: Draft and revise a poem from a seed image, feeling or form, with concrete language, sound control and line breaks that do work.
gotchas: Rhyme that bends the meaning
Abstract words in place of images
Line breaks placed by habit

skills.summary: Write lyrics with hook, verse, chorus
skills.job: Write song lyrics with a clear hook, verse and chorus structure, singable lines and a single emotional idea.
gotchas: Lines that scan on paper but not when sung
A chorus that says what the verses already said
Copying the phrasing of a known song

skills.summary: Format a scene as a screenplay
skills.job: Convert prose or notes into correctly formatted screenplay pages with sluglines, action, dialogue and transitions that show, not tell.
triggers: turn my story into a screenplay
gotchas: Writing thoughts the camera cannot see
Long action blocks
Formatting by eye instead of consistent rules

skills.summary: Critique a short story with specific fixes
skills.job: Give a structured critique of a short story that names what works, what blocks the reader and the three changes with most effect.
triggers: give me feedback on my story
what is wrong with this draft
gotchas: Fixing sentences when the structure is the problem
Rewriting the author's voice into the critic's
Listing twenty notes with no order

skills.summary: Generate prompts with a hook and constraint
skills.job: Generate writing prompts with a character, a situation and a constraint, tuned to a genre, length and purpose.
gotchas: Prompts that are only a premise with no pressure
Generic mix-and-match combinations
Ignoring the writer's genre and skill level

skills.summary: Write a complete story in under 1,000 words
skills.job: Write a complete story at a hard word limit, with one moment, one change and an ending that lands without explanation.
gotchas: Compressing a long plot instead of choosing one moment
Ending with a twist that cheats
Going over the word limit

skills.summary: Craft and test first lines and openings
skills.job: Generate and compare first lines and opening paragraphs for a story, and pick the one that raises a question the reader wants answered.
gotchas: Opening with weather or waking up
A hook that the story does not honor
Starting with backstory

skills.summary: Design an antagonist with a case
skills.job: Design an antagonist with a believable goal, a method and a point of view that makes the hero's choices harder.
triggers: make my bad guy more interesting
gotchas: Evil with no goal
A villain who only exists to oppose
Explaining the villain's plan in a monologue

skills.summary: Design a magic system with costs and limits
skills.job: Design a magic system with clear rules, costs, limits and social consequences, so it creates problems as well as solutions.
triggers: how should magic work in my world
gotchas: Power with no cost
Limits revealed only when the plot needs them
Magic that removes the need for the other characters

skills.summary: Prepare a tabletop RPG adventure
skills.job: Prepare a playable tabletop adventure with a hook, locations, challenges, non-player characters and several routes to the goal.
gotchas: A single required path
Prep that is all lore and no choices
Too many encounters for the session length

skills.summary: Write jokes that fit the audience
skills.job: Write jokes and light humor for a stated audience and occasion, with setup, turn and tag, and flag risky ones.
gotchas: Explaining the punchline
Humor that punches down at someone in the room
Jokes borrowed from a known source

skills.summary: Write a short toast for a celebration
skills.job: Write a toast of one to three minutes for a wedding, retirement or milestone, with one story, one turn and a raised glass.
gotchas: Inside jokes the room cannot follow
Embarrassing stories about the guest of honor
Running longer than two minutes

skills.summary: Write a story for a young child
skills.job: Write a story for a stated age group with simple language, a repeated pattern, a small problem and a satisfying ending.
triggers: a story for my 5 year old
gotchas: A moral stated outright
Vocabulary above the age group
Scary content with no comfort at the end

skills.summary: Keep fan fiction true to the source
skills.job: Plan and check fan fiction against the source canon so characters, timeline and rules stay consistent, and mark where the story diverges.
triggers: continue this story in the same universe
gotchas: Characters acting out of character to fit the plot
Canon recalled from memory instead of checked
Mixing events from conflicting timelines

skills.summary: Generate names for people, places, things
skills.job: Generate names for characters, places, creatures or projects that fit a culture and tone, and check them for unwanted meanings.
gotchas: Names that look alike on the page
A real word with a meaning in another language
Clashing with existing famous names
